title: Iron, mycobactin, and ESX-3
dek: Mtb steals iron with mycobactin/carboxymycobactin and an ESX-3-dependent uptake path. The host sequesters iron; the bacterium budgets around that fight.
story: Iron is essential and sequestered. Mtb synthesises mycobactin (cell-associated) and carboxymycobactin (more soluble) via the mbt gene cluster, then imports iron through membrane transporters with ESX-3 playing an essential role in this metal economy. IdeR represses iron-acquisition genes when iron is plentiful.

The host answers with NRAMP1 (SLC11A1), lactoferrin, and lipocalin-2 (which can bind some siderophores). Granuloma macrophages are an iron-restricted, heme-and-lipid-rich niche. Mtb can also use heme pathways (mmpL3 is not this; heme uptake is a parallel branch).

This is not a first-line drug target in WHO regimens today. It is why ESX-3 is essential, why some experimental siderophore-mimic compounds exist, and why “iron studies” on a TB ward are host nutrition, not DST.
deep: mbtB and friends are biosynthetic. Loss-of-function should be lethal in iron-restricted media if genuine; in a clinical BAM, suspect mapping or a lineage-specific indel before announcing a new auxotroph.
ESX-3 substrates (EsxG/EsxH) are also T-cell antigens (TB10.4 related). Immunology papers and iron papers collide here.
Do not confuse mycobactin with mycolic acid because both start with myco-.
Gallium and other iron-mimic experimental therapies are research. Not BPaLM.

visual.caption: Host sequestration versus mycobactin/ESX-3 uptake. IdeR is the bacterial repressor when iron is already in hand.

example.title: Calling ESX-3 a BCG-like attenuation
example.setup: A draft genome is missing coverage over eccD3. Someone writes “RD1-like attenuation.”

steps.title: Wrong locus
steps.body: RD1 is ESX-1. ESX-3 is iron and essential. A real eccD3 deletion in viable Mtb is surprising.

steps.title: Check the BAM
steps.body: GC-rich dropouts happen. Rescue with long reads or a different mapper before claiming auxotrophy.

steps.title: Clinical meaning
steps.body: Even if real, this is not a DST call and not BCG.
